references.text: Warns against false prophets who come in sheep's clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves
Many will come in Jesus' name and say, 'I am the Messiah,' and they will lead many astray
Many false prophets will arise and lead many astray
Warns against those who bring another gospel
The false beast performs signs and wonders to deceive people
Refers to spirits that perform signs and gather the kings for war on the great day of God Almighty
The false beast and its prophet, who performed signs, are thrown into the lake of fire
